plugins.name: skill-builder
plugins.description: Builds production-ready Claude Code skills using a structured framework: requirements gathering, connector locking, quality gates/rubrics, and a self-improving knowledge base.

plugins.name: skill-builder-v2
plugins.description: The skill builder from the AI Automation Workshop: asks every question up front, builds the skill, and won't call it done until real outputs are approved.

plugins.name: ship-product
plugins.description: The loop for building a whole workflow: intake, spec, a test set before any code, build, label, re-test, then ship, fix or stop.

plugins.name: workflow-flowchart
plugins.description: Turns any multi-step system into an interactive pan-zoom flowchart, colour-coded by who does each step. Built for showing a client how a workflow works.

plugins.name: secure-this
plugins.description: Security audit for any skill or workflow before it goes live: data flow map, prompt-injection checks, and the sandbox config and hooks that contain it.
